# NextGol

> NextGol is your external technology team — bilingual (Spanish/English) senior
> engineers who build, automate, and integrate the software a business needs to
> grow, without the cost and overhead of hiring an in-house team. Nearshore
> pricing, business-outcome focused, part of the TOP CoNNecT community.

NextGol works with two kinds of clients: (1) business owners / SMBs who want to
digitize, automate, and sell more, and (2) startup founders who need a product
built or a dedicated engineering team without hiring and managing engineers.

## What NextGol does

- **AI Automation**: customer support, scheduling, lead follow-up, and reporting. Businesses typically cut operating costs by 40–60%.
- **Custom Software & Cloud (AWS)**: web and mobile apps plus cloud infrastructure, end to end.
- **Integrations & Payments**: connects existing tools and payment gateways, removing manual data entry.
- **AI Team Training**: upskills client teams to multiply productivity.
- **Tech Team for Startups**: dedicated engineers or a full turnkey product.

## How engagements work

Pricing is tailored to each project's scope — one-off projects and monthly
retainers (ongoing support, dedicated team, fractional CTO). Every engagement
starts with a free 30-minute diagnosis call to define scope, timeline, and price.

## Key facts

- Languages: Spanish and English (fully bilingual).
- Model: external/turnkey technology department; nearshore pricing.
- Differentiators: real senior engineering (backend, cloud, data, AI), business-outcome focus, close & bilingual communication, flexible scope.
- Community: members of TOP CoNNecT.
